name: H-2DGS (Height-Field 2D Gaussian Splatting)
definition: A three-stage pipeline that converts a robust volumetric 3DGS reconstruction into a thin, geometrically sharp, and deformable cortical surface using curved height-field Gaussian primitives initialized on a shared TSDF zero level set.
summary: H-2DGS converts volumetric 3D Gaussian Splatting into a thin, geometrically sharp cortical surface using curved height-field primitives on a TSDF, solving depth ambiguity in medical imaging.
